svg.title: Popular Scripting 0.2.45 market profile preview
svg.desc: Fixture-only preview for Ibovespa, Dow Jones, Dólar USD/BRL, and the ICE Brent Crude Futures Jan-2027 contract in the requested order. All four slots use visible local pictograms; USD is the circular United States flag. Names share one 5.5 point semibold line with ellipsis-capable native layout, and no status dot is drawn. IBOV and USD/BRL show daily EOD curve geometry cropped to seven days; those paths are illustrative fixture geometry, not live quotes.
svg.text: Layout fixture · IBOV · DOW · USD/BRL · BRN Jan-27 · EOD 7D · pictogramas locais · sem ponto de status
Curvas EOD são geometria fixture; não substitui dados ao vivo, render nativo nem teste físico no iPhone.
